## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 2-fascicle text by [曇景](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9B%87%E6%99%AF) Tánjǐng is the *Mahāmāyā-sūtra* — the Mahāyāna sūtra concerning the Buddha's mother *Mahāmāyā* 摩訶摩耶, narrating the events surrounding the Buddha's parinirvāṇa from Mahāmāyā's perspective in the Trāyastriṃśa heaven and including a famous *prophecy of the decline of the Dharma* (the standard *mò fǎ* 末法 doctrine).

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to Tánjǐng's Xiāo-Qí period (479–502 CE).
